#FindingTypeStatus
1Customer replies now reach Desk (EM-05). Your reply from mmohamed@ landed on #2382 at 11:11 UTC; on 9 Nov the same kind of reply never arrived. The 9 Nov email bug draft (plane-draft-mail.html, not posted) should not be filed as written: the failure did not repeat.WORKS NOWCause of the 9 Nov loss unknown (fixed since, or a one-off).
1bEmail Overview has no "last mail received" time (EM-08). It said "Mail is arriving … 4 of 4 done" on 9 Nov too, while a reply was lost.GAPImprovement, not a parity gap: Zoho Desk's help pages describe only a forwarding verification status for support addresses, no "last received" time (live Zoho page not opened: the Zoho test account is in use by the other session).
1cReplies from anyware.software are marked "Unverified sender" (dkim_not_aligned). Delivered only because the spam filter is "Deliver everything"; a stricter filter setting would hold them.CONFIGDNS checked 10 Nov: SPF allows only zohomail.com; DMARC p=none; DKIM keys found only for Brevo (brevo1, brevo2), none under the usual Zoho Mail selector names. Likely the mailbox is not DKIM-signing for anyware.software: a mail-admin question. Open: your new emails from the same address (EM-02) were marked trusted while your replies were not; needs the message headers or a developer to explain.
2Backlog skips a ticket without saying why (E18-03). #1 stayed in the backlog for 32 minutes while a newer ticket was assigned in 13 s; its History has no entry like "skipped: no customer reply in the last 30 days".GAPSeen 9 Nov (twice) and 10 Nov. The rule itself works (PASS).
3Reply composer: Send stays disabled when the text is typed inside the quoted message. On a ticket whose first message came from the contact, the composer opens with an empty line above "On … wrote:". Text typed into the quote keeps Send disabled and no message says why.CHECKSeen by automation on #2382. Worth one manual check before filing: click inside the quote, type, and see whether Send enables.
4Ticket #1's closed time came back changed. After the 9 Nov restore it read 12 Oct, but on 10 Nov it was 9 Nov 14:13:30 (the time of the restore). Today's restore still read 12 Oct three minutes later.EXPLAINEDNot a product bug. History shows the only change at 9 Nov 14:13:30 was the status change to Closed by our restore. Setting Closed fills closed time a moment later; on 9 Nov the restore wrote the old date immediately after closing, and the close overwrote it. Today the restore waited 5 s and the value still read 12 Oct at 14:52 UTC.
5The 9 Nov "An unexpected error occurred" on Quarantine and Spam no longer appears (EM-07).FIXED?No Quarantine tab in the page now; its API answers with an empty list. No Plane ticket exists for the old error (searched "Quarantine", "Spam", "unexpected error"), so nothing to close.
6Deleting a contact also deletes its tickets. Controlled test 10 Nov 15:15 UTC (contact + 2 tickets, and again from the contact page): both tickets disappeared with the contact and were listed in the Recycle Bin next to it. The delete dialog says only: "Delete this record? "QA CL6 contact …" moves to the recycle bin, where it can be restored." It does not mention the tickets. Restoring the contact brought back the contact only; its tickets stayed in the Recycle Bin. (Earlier today only the contact was spotted in the bin for #2495/#2498; that lookup was incomplete.)MATCHES ZOHOZoho Desk's help says deleting a contact moves its tickets, activities and time entries to the Recycle Bin, so the cascade is expected. Possible improvements only: name the ticket count in the dialog, and offer to restore the tickets with the contact (Zoho's restore behaviour not checked live). Test data deleted and purged.
